quotes.text: He agreed and began filling his pack. Then he carefully placed his picture of Jesus Christ back on top and zipped it up. quotes.text: The enemy of happiness wants to separate you from Jesus Christ. He will tempt you to remove the Savior from your life, enticing you to think that the road would be easier without Him, that the weight of His commandments is too great, that the path back is too long, that repentance is too hard. Know this: Satan is a liar. Jesus Christ is not the weight; He is the relief.
